_doc: Experiment A, w01 only. Boxes are level-0 canvas px [y0, y1, x0, x1] of supervised components from logs/components_w01.log (scripts/list_components.py: level-4 supervision after a 48 px dilation). The held-out ids 5, 17, 19 (15.0% of the segment's ink at level 4) were chosen by scripts/pick_heldout.py, frozen before the component list existed (logs/heldout_rule_timestamp.txt), output in logs/pick_heldout_w01.log and logs/heldout_w01.json. build_labels.py maps them into the tifxyz frame with the HF65 w01 correction and pads by margin_px; guard_px of supervision around every held-out box is dropped from training in both arms. The smoke boxes are only read by build_labels.py --smoke (a CPU smoke test that A does not need): the smallest training component (id 25) and the smallest held-out component (id 5).
